info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Cancel Rideshare Ride API allows users to efficiently manage their rideshare experience by cancelling scheduled rides. This endpoint is designed for rideshare service providers and their clients, enabling intuitive ride cancellation functionalities with minimal friction. Typical consumers of this API include mobile app developers and service integration teams who need to enhance user control over ride bookings. By providing a straightforward way to cancel rides, this API aims to improve user satisfaction and operational efficiency.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a scheduled ride. Upon cancellation, all associated resources are also released, and the ride will no longer be available in the user's active bookings.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a ride. This should include the necessary parameters required to process the cancellation of the specified ride.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: Request body for the operation to cancel a ride. This should contain a valid string that represents the cancel request.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_201.title: Cancel Ride Response

status.description: Indicates if the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the ride after attempted cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_201.description: Response schema for a successful cancellation of a ride.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details about the creation and processing of the cancellation request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time for the operation that resulted in a 201 response. A value of 0 indicates that the processing was instantaneous.

schema.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
